en.text:
Counts for and benefits from the 'Harmonic Resonance' origin trait.

While the <stasis/>Stasis shot is loaded:
• Benefits from Stasis Armor Mods
• Fires pellets in a triangular spread

While the <solar/>Solar shot is loaded, or the magazine is empty.
• Benefits from Solar Armor Mods
• Fires pellets in a circular spread
